criteria.text: While my product runs, each step with a declared owner shows its part name, including background server work.
After a reload or a completed tap, the same recorded steps keep their part names and existing call counts.
A step with no declared owner does not get an invented part name, and reading or showing a label makes no AI call.

cases.given: Admitted product ownership phone/server/barista; a tap has steps from each area.
cases.required_observation: Live and settled activity show the matching area for every declared step; server remains visible without a screen.

cases.given: Same completed records after reload, with known and unknown call usage.
cases.required_observation: Owner labels survive; known/unknown call accounting remains exact.

cases.given: A recorded prompt has no admitted product owner.
cases.required_observation: No inferred area, no misleading owner label, zero provider calls from display/reads.
